title: runContracts
responsibility: Dispatches one read-only contract query against a fresh stored catalog and returns its text or JSON output.

inputs.name: runContracts.operation
inputs.description: One of show, list, search or map; the CLI admits these four operations before dispatch.

inputs.name: runContracts.query
inputs.description: Search substring or expression, or a show/map identity or path. List ignores this string.

inputs.name: runContracts.options
inputs.description: Root, filters, output mode and operation-specific flags. The CLI validates positive limits and depth bounds before this call.

outputs.name: runContracts
outputs.description: The complete printable result, using indented JSON when requested. Empty list/search are arrays in JSON; missing show/map targets fail.

errors.name: Filesystem rejection
errors.description: Original Node filesystem error while listing a specification directory, except ENOENT which is treated as empty. The original code and message are preserved.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Stored documents are invalid, ids duplicate, paths escape the root, search is empty or invalid, or show/map have no matches.
